brandStory.headline: Born From a Love of Wild Places
brandStory.body: Adventure International was founded in 1998 by naturalist and explorer Marcus Webb after two decades leading expeditions across Africa, South America, and Southeast Asia. What began as a small operation running bespoke African safaris has grown into a global luxury expedition company — but our guiding principle has never changed: every journey we craft must be exceptional, responsible, and deeply personal.

expertisePillars.title: Unrivaled Access
expertisePillars.description: Decades of relationships with private conservancies, local communities, and conservation organizations grant our guests access to places most travelers never see.

expertisePillars.title: Conservation First
expertisePillars.description: A portion of every journey funds direct conservation efforts in the destinations we visit. We believe luxury travel should actively protect the wild places it celebrates.

expertisePillars.title: Small Groups Only
expertisePillars.description: We cap most expeditions at 8–12 guests, ensuring an intimate, personalized experience and minimal environmental footprint.

expertisePillars.title: Extraordinary Expertise
expertisePillars.description: Every itinerary is designed and guided by specialists with deep field experience — naturalists, climbers, surfers, and cultural experts who are passionate about their regions.

team.name: Marcus Webb
team.bio: Marcus has spent over 30 years leading expeditions across six continents. A trained wildlife biologist and passionate photographer, he designed Adventure International's foundational approach to nature-first travel.

team.name: Sofia Reyes
team.bio: Born in Santiago, Chile, Sofia has guided trekkers through Patagonia for 15 years. She leads all Adventure International's South American programs and maintains deep connections with Patagonian conservation trusts.

team.name: James Ochieng
team.bio: A third-generation Kenyan guide, James has an encyclopedic knowledge of East African wildlife and ecosystems. He oversees all Kenya, Tanzania, and Uganda programs and personally guides the Great Migration Classic.
